---
applyTo: "features/**/*.md"
---

# Feature spec rules

- Start from `features/_template.md`; keep all frontmatter keys, even if empty.
- OKF: `type: Feature Spec` is mandatory; fill `description` (one sentence — it becomes the index entry),
  `tags`, `status` (`draft|stable|deprecated`), `stale_after`, `generated.by/at` (`copilot/<agent>` or
  `human:<id>`), and cite Confluence/code evidence in `sources[]` referenced by `[^id]` footnotes.
  Never set `verified[].by: human:<id>` unless you are that person.
- Never add `README.md` under `features/`; folder overviews are `index.md` generated by `scripts/build-index.ps1`.
- Sections in order: Summary → Actors → Business rules → UI flow → API/Events → Data → Calculations →
  Edge cases → Open questions → Change log.
- Business rules are numbered `BR-<ID>-<n>` so tests and work items can cite them.
- Reference calculations by link to `domain/calculations/<name>.md`; do not duplicate formulas.
- Reference endpoints as `METHOD /path` matching `generated/openapi/`; reference Kafka topics by exact name from
  `generated/asyncapi/`.
- `code_refs` are paths relative to the FE/BE repo roots (`be/src/...`, `fe/src/...`), taken from
  `generated/codebase-map.md`.
- Update `last_verified` (ISO date) only after you have checked the spec against current `generated/` artifacts.
- Max ~300 lines per spec; split into sub-features (`HEDGE-012a`) if longer.
